## The new players

Sona 1.7 redraws both of its players in one design language. The music player, its lyrics sheet and the video player are now built from the same controls, so they look, feel and respond alike.

### Music player

- **A new layout.** A header naming what you are playing from, the cover, the title with your favourite and the track's options beside it, the line of lyrics playing, then the seek bar and the controls.
- **Controls that press together.** Shuffle, previous, play, next and repeat are one Material 3 Expressive button group: the one you hold widens while its neighbours make room.
- **Clear on and off.** Shuffle, repeat, open lyrics, a favourite and a running sleep timer are shown on a squared accent while they are on, and play changes colour while paused.
- **Open where you are playing from.** Tap the header to go to the album, artist, playlist, folder or library tab the queue is playing.
- **Time left, or the whole length.** Tap the time at the end of the seek bar to switch between them, in every player.
- **Long titles read the right way.** They scroll in the direction their own language reads, and fade at the edges.

### Video player

- **Redesigned to match the music player.** In portrait, the seek bar with its times sits beneath the picture, the controls below it and the rest at the foot. In landscape, the controls stay over the picture.
- **Shuffle and repeat**, right beside previous, play and next in portrait.
- **Always centred.** The picture stands in the middle of the screen, and the controls line up with it whichever side the camera cutout is on, on a deeper shade so they stay readable over bright scenes.
- **The rotate button shows how the screen is held:** turning with the device, upright or on its side.
- **Quieter feedback.** Changing the rotation or the picture's fit is confirmed with a short toast.

## Also new

- **Choose what to restore from Google Drive** by folder, with how many files and how much space they take. Restored files appear as your newest, in the order you added them on your old device, download several at a time, and a failed restore can be tried again from where it stopped.
- **Sort collections** by length, by plays and by when they were added.
- **Lyrics stay as you leave them.** Lyrics you remove or change yourself are no longer looked up and put back.
- **Clearer names** for editing a track's info, its lyrics and a playlist.

## Fixed

- Albums show their year, and follow a date you edit in Sona.
- Next no longer flickers back while a track repeats, and skipping past either end of the queue goes round to the other.
- Copying shows a confirmation on systems that do not show one themselves.
- A long name no longer stretches the header of an options sheet.
